parameters.jsCode: const requests=$("Format the complete release notice").all();if(!Number.isInteger($runIndex)||$runIndex<0||$runIndex>=requests.length)throw new Error("Invalid release message index");const channel=$("Post one release message to Slack").params.channel;if($json.ok!==true||typeof $json.ts!=="string"||!/^\d+\.\d+$/.test($json.ts)||$json.channel!==channel)throw new Error("Slack did not confirm the release message in the requested channel; posting may already have occurred");return {json:{part:requests[$runIndex].json.index,action:requests[$runIndex].json.action,message:$json}};
